title: Organizational sign-in needs deployment authentication evidence
remediation: The deployment sponsor approves the in-scope sign-in paths, account classes, accounts and services assigned to single sign-on, replay resistance selections and reauthentication triggers. Identity and component operators trace unique user identities to processes acting for them. Collect redacted policy exports and results showing strong multi-factor authentication for privileged accounts, multi-factor authentication for non-privileged accounts, replay refusal, single sign-on to assigned services and a fresh challenge at each applicable trigger. Use G3 relay ingress and Phase 76 requester binding only for that part of the deployment. Assign implementation or inheritance verification where a path lacks evidence.

milestones.title: Approve the organizational sign-in inventory and collect configuration, actor binding, multi-factor, replay denial, single sign-on and reauthentication receipts
